attchmntText: Veegaland Developers Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Veegaland Developers Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 and H1 FY2027 earnings conference call held on November 09, 2026. The company reported revenue from operations of INR106.34 crores for Q2 FY27, a 28.66% increase year-on-year. Profit after tax for the quarter was INR15.99 crores, up 92%. For H1 FY27, revenue stood at INR180.66 crores, with PAT at INR25.71 crores, a 123% increase. The company completed its initial public offering, raising INR210 crores, with shares listed on September 18, 2026. Pre-sales grew by 37.6% in value terms during the quarter. The IPO proceeds are designated for funding ongoing projects, planned acquisitions, and general corporate purposes. Management indicated that two upcoming projects are scheduled for launch in Q3 FY27.

attchmntText: Veegaland Developers Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Veegaland Developers Limited has hosted the audio recording of its earnings call regarding financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The call was scheduled for November 09, 2026. The recording is available on the company website at https://www.veegaland.com/investor-relations/. This filing serves as an intimation to the BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The company previously filed an intimation on November 04, 2026, under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. Akshay Anand T S, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, signed the communication.

attchmntText: Veegaland Developers Limited has informed the Exchange about change in Management - Appointment of Secretarial Auditor
voiceSummary: Veegaland Developers Limited announced the outcome of its Board meeting held on November 09, 2026. The Board approved the appointment of Dr. George Sleeba, DIN 01217286, as an Additional Director and Whole-time Director with the designation Executive Director. This appointment is for a term of three consecutive years from November 10, 2026, to November 09, 2029, subject to shareholder approval through a postal ballot process. Dr. Sleeba currently holds 65,000 shares, representing 0.13% of the company. Concurrently, Mr. Kurian Thomas, DIN 10279590, resigned from his position as Whole-time Director and Key Managerial Personnel, effective from the closure of business hours on November 09, 2026. Mr. Thomas cited other interests as the reason for his resignation and confirmed no other material reasons exist. The Board also approved the appointment of M/s. Dedhia Shah & Partners LLP, Firm registration number L2025MH019000, as Secretarial Auditors for five consecutive years from Financial Year 2026-27 to 2030-31, subject to shareholder approval via postal ballot. The notice for these appointments will be sent to shareholders. The trading window for the company's securities, closed since November 08, 2026, will reopen on November 12, 2026.

attchmntText: Veegaland Developers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Trading Window closure pursuant to SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015
voiceSummary: Veegaland Developers Limited has closed its trading window for dealing in company securities effective November 08, 2026, until further notice. This closure is in compliance with SEBI Prohibition of Insider Trading Regulations, 2015, and the company's internal code of conduct. Designated persons, their immediate relatives, and other insiders are advised not to trade in the equity shares during this period. The intimation is submitted for the records of BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The company's scrip code is 544923 and symbol is VEEGALAND. Akshay Anand T S, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, membership number A70026, issued this communication on November 08, 2026.

attchmntText: Veegaland Developers Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Veegaland Developers Limited submitted an investor presentation regarding unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Pre-sales increased 37.56% year on year to Rs. 174.34 crore. Gross collections rose 88.22% year on year to Rs. 125.22 crore. Revenue from operations grew 28.66% year on year to Rs. 106.34 crore. EBITDA increased 77.76% year on year to Rs. 22.78 crore. Profit after tax rose 92.34% year on year to Rs. 15.99 crore. The total order value stands at Rs. 1086.79 crore. Unrecognised revenue is Rs. 501.35 crore. Debt-equity ratio decreased to 0.15x from 0.32x. The company has 12 ongoing projects and 3 upcoming projects.
